llm.responses/authored/egress-writes-the.purpose: parallel tool calls, the cache key, verbosity and the reasoning summary reach the wire

llm.responses/authored/encoding-a-caller.purpose: an outcome carrying a tool result, which the caller owns, is refused rather than answered

error_message.value: model outcome contains caller-owned content

llm.responses/authored/encoding-a-non-st.purpose: a non-streamed response object carries the whole turn and reads back unchanged

llm.responses/authored/encoding-a-stop-r.purpose: a reason that would read back as another one is refused rather than approximated

error_message.value: the Responses wire cannot report this terminal reason

llm.responses/authored/encoding-a-stream.purpose: a streamed turn with reasoning, text and two calls reads back unchanged

llm.responses/authored/encoding-an-end-t.purpose: an answer that ends its turn reads back as an end turn

llm.responses/authored/encoding-an-incom.purpose: an incomplete turn names its reason and reads back with that reason

llm.responses/authored/encoding-an-outco.purpose: an outcome that renames a call already announced on the stream is refused

error_message.value: model outcome contradicts what was already streamed

llm.responses/authored/encoding-an-unkno.purpose: an input count the upstream never reported is left out and reads back unknown, never zero

llm.responses/authored/encoding-an-unrep.purpose: an answer leaves out a model the upstream never reported and names the caller's response id, not the upstream's

llm.responses/authored/encoding-argument.purpose: a call whose arguments are not a JSON object is refused, because the decoder would refuse to read it back

error_message.value: the Responses wire carries only tool arguments that are a JSON object

llm.responses/authored/encoding-fail-end.purpose: a stream that fails after output ends with one failed response the decoder reads as the same class

failure_json.value: {"code":"rate-limited","message":"upstream prose that must not be relayed","dispatch":"accepted"}

llm.responses/authored/encoding-text-aft.purpose: text streamed after a call opens a new message item, so each message shows its own text once

llm.responses/authored/encoding-the-outp.purpose: a turn stopped by the output cap ends incomplete and reads back as max output tokens

llm.responses/authored/encoding-unattrib.purpose: opaque state no caller bound is refused by name rather than answered or dropped

error_message.value: unattributed opaque state is not sendable until a caller binds it to a target

llm.responses/authored/ingress-carries-a.purpose: ingress carries a reasoning entry JSON-equal as unattributed state, and its own egress will not forward it unbound

llm.responses/authored/ingress-item-ids-.purpose: item ids and client_metadata are read as unforwarded hints and reported omitted

llm.responses/authored/ingress-joins-ins.purpose: instructions then every part of the opening developer messages, joined by a line feed

llm.responses/authored/ingress-reads-a-p.purpose: a function_call_output string outside the envelope is a successful result carrying that string

llm.responses/authored/ingress-reads-an-.purpose: a result string shaped like the envelope with a field beside ok and output is not the envelope, so it is a successful result carrying that string

llm.responses/authored/ingress-reads-ins.purpose: a top-level instructions string is the instructions, sent back as the developer message

llm.responses/authored/ingress-reads-the.purpose: the captured first Codex turn ingests with joined instructions, its controls and its unforwarded hints

llm.secrets.ProbeEnvironment/outcome/obs.purpose: `llm.secrets.ProbeEnvironment` answers `observed` for an input no other branch's guard claims

llm.secrets.ProbeFile/outcome/observed.purpose: `llm.secrets.ProbeFile` answers `observed` for an input no other branch's guard claims

llm.secrets.ProbeKeychain/outcome/observ.purpose: `llm.secrets.ProbeKeychain` answers `observed` for an input no other branch's guard claims

llm.secrets.ProbePointer/outcome/observe.purpose: `llm.secrets.ProbePointer` answers `observed` for an input no other branch's guard claims

llm.secrets.ProbeSecretsLibrary/outcome/.purpose: `llm.secrets.ProbeSecretsLibrary` answers `observed` for an input no other branch's guard claims

llm.secrets.RenewCodexLogin/outcome/obse.purpose: `llm.secrets.RenewCodexLogin` answers `observed` for an input no other branch's guard claims

llm.secrets/authored/codex-read-a-login-.purpose: the read-only resolver refuses a whole document that is not JSON as malformed, a configuration error no fallback takes

llm.secrets/authored/codex-read-a-trunca.purpose: the read-only resolver refuses a login cut off mid-document as unavailable, since a file being rewritten in place reads that way

llm.secrets/authored/codex-read-an-undat.purpose: the read-only resolver refuses an access token whose exp cannot be read as malformed, a configuration error no fallback takes

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-a-dir.purpose: a directory at the login path is refused as not a regular file and nothing is sent

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-a-due.purpose: a login inside its margin is renewed by one refresh grant and only its token values change on disk, mode kept, no stray file
a due login with nothing at /tokens/refresh_token refuses naming that pointer before anything is sent

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-a-dup.purpose: a document naming tokens twice is refused as malformed, as the read rule refuses it, before sending

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-a-gro.purpose: a 0640 login is renewed and stays 0640

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-a-har.purpose: a login with a second hard link is refused before sending, so the rename cannot split it

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-a-kep.purpose: an answer that repeats the refresh token on disk renews the access token and reports no rotation

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-a-log.purpose: a token expiring exactly at the margin is due and renewed
a file rewritten while the refresh request was in flight is kept and the renewal refuses
a token expiring one second after the margin is not due, nothing is sent and the file is untouched
a whole document that is not JSON is refused as malformed, nothing is sent and the file is kept

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-a-mis.purpose: no file at the path is refused as missing and nothing is sent

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-a-non.purpose: an answer whose id token is not a string refuses and the file is untouched

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-a-ref.purpose: a 400 from the token endpoint refuses the renewal without quoting its body or the refresh token, and writes nothing
after the endpoint refused a grant the renewing resolver refuses the next resolve of the unchanged login without sending

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-a-rel.purpose: a relative login path is refused as not absolute and nothing is sent

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-a-rep.purpose: a refresh token copied under a second key is replaced at its pointer only and every other byte survives

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-a-ser.purpose: a 503 from the token endpoint is final after one request and leaves the outcome uncertain

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-a-sym.purpose: a symlink at the login path is refused before sending and its target is kept

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-a-tru.purpose: a login cut off mid-document is refused as unavailable, as the read rule refuses it, nothing is sent and the file is kept

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-an-an.purpose: an answer carrying only an access token replaces it and leaves the refresh and id tokens as they were

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-an-em.purpose: an answer with an empty access token refuses and the file is untouched
an answer with an empty refresh token refuses and the file is untouched

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-an-ex.purpose: a token already past its expiry is due and renewed

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-an-ov.purpose: a file above 1 MiB is refused as too large and nothing is sent

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-an-un.purpose: after a server failure left a grant uncertain the next resolve of the unchanged login refuses uncertain without sending
an access token whose exp cannot be read is left alone, no refresh token is spent and nothing is written
the renewing resolver leaves an undated token alone and still refuses to send it, as malformed
a directory that cannot take a new file refuses write-failed after the grant, as uncertain, and the login is kept

llm.secrets/authored/codex-renewal-the-r.purpose: the read-only resolver refuses an expired login and never contacts the endpoint
the renewing resolver renews an expired login and answers the access token the endpoint issued
the renewing resolver answers a token outside its margin without contacting the endpoint

llm.secrets/authored/environment-exact-b.purpose: a caller-named environment variable resolves to its exact bytes, trailing newline included, and is read-only

llm.secrets/authored/environment-unbound.purpose: a reference bound to no variable is missing even when the fixture variable is set

llm.secrets/authored/environment-unset.purpose: an unset caller-named variable is missing, and its refusal names the reference, never the variable

llm.secrets/authored/file-group-readable.purpose: a leaf file readable by its group is refused (file.rs regular)

llm.secrets/authored/file-group-writable.purpose: a parent directory writable by its group is refused (file.rs directory)

llm.secrets/authored/file-other-writable.purpose: a parent directory writable by others alone is refused (file.rs directory)

llm.secrets/authored/file-owner-executab.purpose: a leaf file with owner execution permission is refused (file.rs regular)

llm.secrets/authored/file-owner-read-onl.purpose: an owner-read-only leaf in a private directory resolves (docs/local-secrets.md 0400)

llm.secrets/authored/file-refusal-names-.purpose: a missing file's refusal names the reference that refused, never the path or the value

llm.secrets/authored/file-setuid-bit-ref.purpose: a leaf file carrying a special mode bit is refused (file.rs regular)

llm.secrets/authored/file-unsafe-refusal.purpose: a symlinked file's unsafe-source refusal names the reference that refused, never the path or the value

llm.secrets/authored/pointer-absent.purpose: a JSON document with nothing at the caller-named pointer is missing, and its refusal names the reference

llm.secrets/authored/pointer-empty-strin.purpose: an empty string at the caller-named pointer is missing, as an empty Codex access token is

llm.secrets/authored/pointer-escaped-seg.purpose: a pointer follows RFC 6901 escapes, so `~1` is a slash and `~0` a tilde inside one member name

llm.secrets/authored/pointer-non-string.purpose: a JSON number at the caller-named pointer is malformed (a configuration error), not coerced into a token

llm.secrets/authored/pointer-not-json.purpose: a document that is not JSON is malformed when a pointer was named, and is never read as a bare token

llm.secrets/authored/pointer-token-at-po.purpose: a token at a caller-named JSON pointer of a protected file resolves to exactly that string, and is read-only

llm.secrets/authored/pointer-unbound-ref.purpose: a reference bound to no pointer is missing, even when the document holds the token

llm.secrets/authored/secrets-library-bac.purpose: a secrets library backend error is unavailable and redacted

llm.secrets/authored/secrets-library-den.purpose: a scope the local authorizer denies is unsafe-source

llm.secrets/authored/secrets-library-inv.purpose: a reference that is not a secrets name is an invalid reference

llm.secrets/authored/secrets-library-mis.purpose: a name the secrets library does not hold is missing

llm.secrets/authored/secrets-library-rer.purpose: a value rewritten in the secrets library is read again under a new version

llm.secrets/authored/secrets-library-rou.purpose: a route reference resolves through the secrets library keychain backend

llm.secrets/authored/secrets-library-sam.purpose: rewriting the same value in the secrets library is a new version

llm.secrets/authored/secrets-library-uns.purpose: a backend without read capability is unsupported-platform

llm.transport.Exchange/outcome/observed.purpose: `llm.transport.Exchange` answers `observed` for an input no other branch's guard claims

llm.transport.PostJson/outcome/observed.purpose: `llm.transport.PostJson` answers `observed` for an input no other branch's guard claims

llm.transport/authored/a-body-at-the-req.purpose: a body of exactly 16 MiB is sent

llm.transport/authored/a-body-one-byte-o.purpose: a body one byte over 16 MiB is refused as too large and never sent

llm.transport/authored/a-caller-instant-.purpose: an absolute instant the caller holds bounds the response headers even when every client limit is longer
the caller instant also bounds every read of the returned stream

llm.transport/authored/a-cancellation-be.purpose: a caller already cancelled is refused before any connection is made

llm.transport/authored/a-cancellation-cl.purpose: cancelling a stream that is waiting on a silent server ends it at once, dispatch accepted

llm.transport/authored/a-cancellation-wh.purpose: a cancellation that arrives while the stream waits on a silent server ends the wait at once, dispatch accepted
cancelling after the request left but before its answer reports cancelled with unknown dispatch

llm.transport/authored/a-clean-end-of-st.purpose: payloads arrive in order with their event names, and a clean end of stream ends the stream once (sse.rs, transport.rs SseStream::next)

llm.transport/authored/a-client-error-is.purpose: any other 4xx is refused with dispatch rejected

llm.transport/authored/a-forbidden-statu.purpose: 403 is unauthorized with dispatch rejected, like 401

llm.transport/authored/a-frame-whose-dat.purpose: a data frame that is not JSON is a protocol refusal

llm.transport/authored/a-line-over-the-e.purpose: a single SSE line one byte over 1 MiB is refused as too large, however the network split it

llm.transport/authored/a-payload-after-t.purpose: a frame after [DONE] is refused as a protocol failure at once, not at end of stream; the frames before it stay observable

llm.transport/authored/a-rate-limit-carr.purpose: 429 is rate-limited with dispatch rejected and its delta-seconds hint, and nothing is resent

llm.transport/authored/a-redirect-is-nev.purpose: a 307 is refused with dispatch unknown and the redirect target is never contacted

llm.transport/authored/a-server-failure-.purpose: a 5xx is a transport failure whose dispatch is unknown, because the work may have run

llm.transport/authored/a-server-that-nev.purpose: no response head within its bound is a deadline whose dispatch is unknown, because the request was sent

llm.transport/authored/a-success-that-is.purpose: a 200 without text/event-stream is a protocol refusal after acceptance

llm.transport/authored/a-timeout-longer-.purpose: a bound one millisecond over a day is refused when the client is built

llm.transport/authored/a-timeout-of-exac.purpose: a bound of exactly one day is admitted

llm.transport/authored/a-truncated-strea.purpose: end of stream inside a frame is a refusal, not a completion; the prefix survives, the refusal repeats, and nothing is resent

llm.transport/authored/a-zero-timeout-is.purpose: a zero bound is refused when the client is built

llm.transport/authored/adversary-w2-a-re.purpose: 408 is a transport failure with dispatch unknown, like a server failure (transport.rs:246); no authored scenario sends 408
an HTTP-date Retry-After already past is a zero hint whatever the wall clock reads (transport.rs:264-267)

llm.transport/authored/adversary-w2-crlf.purpose: CRLF line endings end one line each (sse.rs:91), two data lines join with a newline, and the event name survives its leading space; every authored transport scenario uses LF and no event name

llm.transport/authored/adversary-w2-the-.purpose: 599 is the upper edge of the server-failure range (transport.rs:246) and is a transport failure with dispatch unknown

llm.transport/authored/ambient-proxy-var.purpose: with every proxy variable naming a local listener and no exemption, the request still goes only to the caller-selected endpoint (transport.rs HttpClient::new no_proxy)

llm.transport/authored/an-authentication.purpose: 401 is unauthorized with dispatch rejected, and the error body is never copied into the diagnostic

llm.transport/authored/an-endpoint-carry.purpose: a password without a user name in the endpoint URL is refused as invalid and nothing is sent

llm.transport/authored/an-endpoint-namin.purpose: a user name alone in the endpoint URL is refused as invalid and nothing is sent

llm.transport/authored/an-endpoint-with-.purpose: a fragment in the endpoint URL is refused as invalid and nothing is sent
userinfo in the endpoint URL is refused as invalid and nothing is sent

llm.transport/authored/an-event-stream-m.purpose: the media type is compared without its parameters and without regard to case

llm.transport/authored/an-unrunnable-pro.purpose: a program that cannot be read starts no server and sends nothing

llm.transport/authored/connect-a-connect.purpose: a connect bound one millisecond over a day is refused when the client is built
a connect bound of exactly one day is admitted and the exchange completes
a connection the far side never establishes ends at the connect bound as a retriable transport failure, before the response-header deadline

llm.transport/authored/connect-a-zero-co.purpose: a zero connect bound is refused when the client is built

llm.transport/authored/connect-without-a.purpose: the control for the connect bound; with the default connect bound, a connection never established waits for the shorter response-header deadline, so the fixture really leaves the connection hanging

llm.transport/authored/json-exchange-a-j.purpose: one JSON POST returns the JSON document the server answered

llm.transport/authored/json-exchange-a-r.purpose: a 429 is rate-limited and not retriable, after one request
a 307 is refused and the redirect target is never contacted
a 400 is refused with dispatch rejected and neither body reaches the diagnostic

llm.transport/authored/json-exchange-a-s.purpose: a 503 is a transport failure with dispatch unknown that is not retriable, after one request
a 200 whose body is not JSON is a protocol refusal with dispatch accepted that quotes no body

llm.transport/authored/json-exchange-an-.purpose: an answer of exactly 65536 bytes is read whole
an answer of 65537 bytes is refused as too large and not retriable

llm.transport/authored/json-exchange-not.purpose: a refused connection is a transport failure that is not retriable

llm.transport/authored/keepalives-cannot.purpose: comment keepalives reset nothing that bounds the whole exchange; the total deadline still ends it

llm.transport/authored/payloads-only-fra.purpose: without sentinel framing [DONE] is data that is not JSON, and is refused rather than read as an ending

llm.transport/authored/retry-class-a-bad.purpose: 400 is a refusal the identical request meets again, so it is final

llm.transport/authored/retry-class-a-cle.purpose: an exchange that refused nothing reports no retry class

llm.transport/authored/retry-class-a-con.purpose: 409 is a disagreement about state that the identical request meets again, so it is final

llm.transport/authored/retry-class-a-cut.purpose: the class says what was observed, not whether anything was shown; a cut after a whole event is retriable and routing decides on visibility

llm.transport/authored/retry-class-a-fra.purpose: a malformed frame is a protocol refusal the identical request meets again, so unlike a cut stream it is final

llm.transport/authored/retry-class-a-rat.purpose: 429 is retriable, rejected, and carries its server delay; the transport itself still sends once

llm.transport/authored/retry-class-a-red.purpose: a redirect status is refused, never followed and final

llm.transport/authored/retry-class-a-req.purpose: 408 is a retriable transport failure whose dispatch stays unknown, and the transport itself sends once

llm.transport/authored/retry-class-a-ser.purpose: 500 is a retriable transport failure whose dispatch stays unknown, because the work may have run

llm.transport/authored/retry-class-a-str.purpose: an end of stream inside the first event yields nothing and is a retriable protocol refusal; dispatch stays accepted and nothing is resent here

llm.transport/authored/retry-class-an-ov.purpose: 529, an unregistered overloaded status, lands with the 5xx range as a retriable transport failure

llm.transport/authored/retry-class-an-un.purpose: 401 is unauthorized and final; another attempt with the same credential is refused the same way
503, a gateway still starting a backend, is a retriable transport failure with dispatch unknown

llm.transport/authored/silence-past-the-.purpose: a stream that goes silent for longer than the idle bound ends in a deadline, dispatch accepted

llm.transport/authored/sixty-five-reques.purpose: a request with 65 caller headers is refused as too large and never sent

llm.transport/authored/sixty-four-reques.purpose: a request with exactly 64 caller headers is sent

llm.transport/authored/the-done-sentinel.purpose: with sentinel framing a [DONE] frame is its own event, and the stream then ends cleanly

llm.transport/authored/the-first-redirec.purpose: 300 is the lower edge of the redirect range and is refused with dispatch unknown
